_header.notes: New items only (the ROM items are read from the ROM). 2026-11-15 (Items Review Lab): added the optional fields desc, who, shop ('always' | 'party' = only when a party Pokemon can use it | 'off'), from_gym (Gym N shop = N-1 bosses beaten; the code has no stage gate, so 1), reward (boss pick / event item pool). They mirror core/src/run.ts DESIGN_SHOP_ITEMS and designShopItems; the game does not read the new fields. The tm record is a schema example: the 48 TMs live in learnsets_draft.json (tms). 2026-11-21 (Items Review Lab, enabled toggle): added top-level `rules` rows { key: 'rom:<Item.dat index>' | 'design:<id>' | 'tm:<tm70 / hm01>', enabled?: false, shop?, from_gym?, reward?, price?, desc? } written by tools/design_apply_items.py from a lab export. The game honours ONLY `enabled: false` (core parseItemRules: the item is in no shop, reward or event; a copy in a bag stays). No row = enabled. The other fields record the decision (shop section / Gym / price / our own description) for the shop rewrite. Keyed by index, never by ROM name or text.
